items.headline: Oviedo me backpack dhamaka, police adhikari ki maut
items.detail: Spain ke Oviedo me goli-bari ki jaanch ke dauraan ek backpack me chhupa bomb phata — ek police adhikari aur uska kutta mare gaye, bomb-nirodhak visheshagya gambhir roop se ghayal hua.

items.headline: Iran khatre par America ne UK base se vimaan hataye
items.detail: Iran se khatre ke baad America ne RAF Mildenhall se kam se kam 10 tanker vimaan asthaayi roop se Germany, Spain aur Scotland bhej diye; base ki suraksha star bhi badhaya gaya.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav aur paschimi sainya taiyaari — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi vaarta: pehla din kathin, aaj doosra din
items.detail: Ukraine-Russia-America vaarta ka pehla satra lagbhag 4 ghante chala; Kremlin ne ise 'kathin lekin rachnaatmak' bataya — suraksha guarantee aur oorja-yuddhviram par baatchit aaj 11 November ko phir shuru hogi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shaanti vaarta aur suraksha guarantee — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia ki tel refining kshamata 30% giri
items.detail: Reuters ke anusaar October ke ant se Ukraine ke drone hamlo ne Russia ki tel shodhan kshamata lagbhag 30% ghata di; pichhle hafte 35 me se 9 badi refinery prabhavit hui aur Kirishi refinery me aag lagi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine oorja yuddh aur vaishvik tel bazaar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UAE ke paani me ADNOC jahaz par hamla
items.detail: Arabian Gulf me UAE ke samudri kshetra me hamle ke baad ADNOC Logistics and Services ke ek jahaz ko nuksaan pahuncha; jahaz ki pehchan aur nuksaan ka vivaran abhi nahi diya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me samudri suraksha aur oorja vyaapaar par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kenya me al-Shabaab hamle me 8 ki maut
items.detail: Mandera me sadak-nirman team ki suraksha gaadi par sandehspad al-Shabaab hamle me 5 mazdoor, 2 police reservist aur driver mare gaye; hamla subah 7 baje hua.
items.exam_angle: Kenya-Somalia seema par al-Shabaab aur suraksha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Spain me train driver hadtaal, 40% train radd
items.detail: Saal ki doosri ghaatak rail durghatna ke baad Spain ke train driver mangalvaar ko hadtaal par gaye; Renfe ne 40% lambi-doori ki train radd ki, 4,042 yatri prabhavit hue.
items.exam_angle: Spain me rail suraksha sankat aur mazdoor andolan — pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: South Africa: ANC ko sabse badi haar
items.detail: South Africa ke sthaniya chunaav me ANC ko sirf 32.5% vote mile — 2021 se lagbhag 15 point ki girawat; DA 22.9% aur Zuma ki MK party 9.9% par rahi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa ki rajneeti aur ANC ka patan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UK: Samundar ke neeche khatre par £90 million
items.detail: Britain Royal Navy ke liye drone, sensor aur AI par £90 million kharch karega, taaki Russian pandubbiyon se samundar ke neeche ke cable aur oorja dhaanche ki raksha ho sake.
items.exam_angle: UK ki Atlantic Bastion yojana aur samundar ke neeche suraksha

items.headline: Poland: Russian jasusi me 2 Ukraini giraftar
items.detail: Poland ne do Ukraini nagrikon ko Russian khufia seva ke liye jasusi aur tod-phod ke aarop me giraftar kiya; dono par sainya suvidhaon ki jaanch aur gaadiyon me aag lagane ka aarop hai.
items.exam_angle: Poland me hybrid yuddh aur Russian jasusi — Europe ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Denmark Ukraine ko $721 million ke hathiyar dega
items.detail: Denmark Ukraine ko 4.8 billion kroner (lagbhag $721 million) ke sainya upkaran dega; videsh mantri ne TV2 ko bataya, yeh 32va sahayata package hoga.
items.exam_angle: Denmark ki Ukraine sahayata aur NATO sahyog

items.headline: M. John Harrison ne Booker Prize jeeta
items.detail: 81 saal ke M. John Harrison ko unke upanyas 'The End of Everything' ke liye 2026 Booker Prize mila; ve is puraskar ke sabse umr-daraaz vijeta bane.
items.exam_angle: Booker Prize 2026 — sahitya aur puraskar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: 8 kshetron me Ukraine ki bijli par hamla
items.detail: Ukrenergo ke anusaar Russia ne raat bhar Kyiv, Kharkiv, Sumy sahit 8 kshetron ki oorja suvidhaon par hamla kiya, 6 kshetron me bijli gul ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh: oorja dhaanche par hamle

items.headline: France: Iran par fridge hack ka aarop
items.detail: France ne Iran ke rajdoot ko bulakar virodh jataya — Iran ke Revolutionary Guard par October me saikadon supermarket ke fridge hack karne ka aarop hai; Paris EU pratibandh chahta hai, Iran ne aarop kharij kiya.
items.exam_angle: France-Iran cyber takraav aur hybrid warfare — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Congo me 66 sainikon ko maut ki saza
items.detail: Purvi Congo ki sainya adalat ne 66 sainikon ko dushman ke saamne kayarta, baghawat aur aadesh na manne par maut ki saza sunayi; 4 ko bari kar diya gaya, ek ko 10 saal ki jail hui.
items.exam_angle: Congo me M23 sangharsh aur sainya anushasan

items.headline: California ne billionaire tax prastav kharij kiya
items.detail: California ke matdataon ne ek-baar ke 5% billionaire tax wale Proposition 40 ko 52.8% se kharij kar diya; AP ne 'no' paksh ki jeet ghoshit ki.
items.exam_angle: America me kar niti aur chunav — pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Anthropic ka $70bn IPO plan wapas liya
items.detail: Anthropic ne $70–80 prati share par lagbhag 867 million share bechne ki IPO filing banks ko bheji, phir keemat galat batakar wapas le li; roadshow mangalvaar se shuru hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: Duniya ka sabse bada AI IPO aur tech nivesh — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi me Ukraine shaanti vaarta shuru
items.detail: Russia, Ukraine aur America ke beech do din ki teen-pakshiya vaarta Abu Dhabi me shuru hui — February ke baad pehli baar; suraksha guarantee aur yuddh-viraam par baat hogi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur shaanti vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: China ka trade surplus $1.04 trillion paar
items.detail: China ka vyaapaar adhishesh January-October me $1.04 trillion raha — doosre saal $1 trillion paar, pichhle saal se ek mahina pehle; October me niryat 35.2% badha, AI upkaran ki maang ne badhat di.
items.exam_angle: China ki arthvyavastha aur vaishvik vyaapaar — arthvyavastha aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Australia AI suraksha niyamak banayega
items.detail: Australia ek naya AI suraksha niyamak banayega aur AI companiyon par sakht zimmedariyan lagayega, June me OpenAI agent ke sarkari Medicare portal me ghusne ke baad.
items.exam_angle: AI suraksha niyaman aur cyber suraksha — vigyaan-tech ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Eisenkot ko Israel sarkar banane ka mauka
items.detail: Rashtrapati Herzog ne Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka pehla mauka diya — 67 sansadon ne sifarish ki; Eisenkot ne Netanyahu ke Likud ko apne netritva wali sarkar me shamil hone ka nyota diya. (Corrected: Yashar ke rukh wala hissa sudhara gaya.)
items.exam_angle: Israel me sarkar-gathan aur Netanyahu ke baad ki rajneeti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Boeing 2,500 naukriyan kaatega, utpadan dheema
items.detail: Boeing apne commercial airplanes division ki lagbhag 5% naukriyan kaatega, karib 2,500 pad prabhavit honge; 737 MAX ka utpadan lakshya 2027 tak tal gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Vishva arthvyavastha aur aviation udyog — pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Damascus me Macron ke hotel ke paas do dhamake
items.detail: Syria yatra ke dusre din Damascus me Four Seasons Hotel ke paas do visfot hue, 18 log ghayal hue jinme chaar policekarmi hain; Macron surakshit hain aur unki yatra jaari rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Assad ke baad Syria me pehli badi pashchimi yatra — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Riyadh ki taraf do Houthi missile giraye
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki taraf daage gaye ek ballistic aur ek cruise missile ko rok kar nasht kar diya; dakshin kshetra ki taraf daaga ek aur missile bhi giraya gaya, koi nuksaan ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi tanav aur Hormuz — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
